"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    arrays = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    for arr in arrays:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All values must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All values must be nonpositive")
    # Check shapes
    shape = arrays[0].shape
    for arr in arrays[1:]:
        if arr.shape != shape:
            raise ValueError("All input matrices must have same shape")
    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted negative log probability losses
    L_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    # Margin
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
    # Keep condition
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
